video_title: Denver Nuggets Training Camp Day One | Practice Media Availability

quotes.speaker: Unidentified speaker
quotes.summary_phrase: Unidentified speaker emphasizes the importance of increased athleticism and physicality from the team's bench.
quotes.quote: It has been years since we have had I would say right now the back end of our team be this athletic, which really helps our starters. So there was a lot of physicality picking up full. We talked about that yesterday. There is a lot of questions about it. I brought it up a lot. It is what the NBA is now. So to have guys like Bryce, Bryce Hopkins picking up Jamal, picking up Aaron and pushing them is what we need because you can be in shape, but you have to be in game shape and that includes physicality.
quotes.social_post: Unidentified speaker says the team's back end is more athletic than it has been in years, which is pushing the starters to get into better game shape through increased physicality.

quotes.speaker: Unidentified speaker
quotes.summary_phrase: Unidentified speaker welcomes Dave Joerger to the coaching staff, citing his impressive offensive schemes in Memphis.
quotes.quote: He will help me with the offense. You know, Dave is a head coach. I know our offense has been really good for a long time. It is nice to have somebody with fresh ideas. You know, I thought the stuff he ran in Memphis was really impressive. He interviewed me a long time ago to work for him in Sacramento. That interview was one of the most fun I have ever had. We just talked basketball for a night and a day.
quotes.social_post: Unidentified speaker is excited to have Dave Joerger on the coaching staff, noting that his offensive work in Memphis was impressive and that he brings fresh ideas to the team.

quotes.speaker: Unidentified speaker
quotes.summary_phrase: Unidentified speaker explains the plan to transition DeRon Holmes II to the power forward position.
quotes.quote: I think for DeRon it is just to try to find a way to be a four because we know what he can do as a five. I started him last year because I liked him against traditional fives during that winter month where a lot of guys were out, and that allowed him to pick and pop, which is his special gift. The guy can really shoot it, but I think in our league he is going to have to be interchangeable and to play the four he is going to have to learn to guard smaller guys.
quotes.social_post: Unidentified speaker says the goal for DeRon Holmes II is to transition to the four position, noting that he needs to learn to guard smaller players to be more interchangeable.

quotes.speaker: Unidentified speaker
quotes.summary_phrase: Unidentified speaker explains the team's decision to hold training camp in Puerto Rico.
quotes.quote: We were going to go to LA, but I figured let us do something out of the norm, you know. Everybody goes to LA. Some of the other teams were overseas. I think a couple of the teams were in Paris and the team was in Slovenia. So I thought all right cool, let us travel too. So we went to Puerto Rico. It was nice, nice facilities over there and we got some work in and hung out on the beach and it was a good time, man. Just traveling does something for the mind, you know, and it was good for the young guys to be expansive.
quotes.social_post: Unidentified speaker says the team chose to hold training camp in Puerto Rico to do something out of the norm, noting that the travel was good for the team's mindset and the young players.

quotes.speaker: Unidentified speaker
quotes.summary_phrase: Unidentified speaker expects the game to be easier with the Nuggets due to less pressure.
quotes.quote: Everything is just going to be easier for me to be honest with you. I do not see no difference other than the pressure is not on me like it has always been throughout my career. So that will make my job a lot easier, you know, and I want to make everybody else's job easier as well. So just going out there playing, you know, being free.
quotes.social_post: Unidentified speaker says he expects the game to be easier for him this season because the pressure is not solely on him, allowing him to play freely and help his teammates.

quotes.speaker: Unidentified speaker
quotes.summary_phrase: Unidentified speaker notes Coach Adelman's unexpected intensity during practice.
quotes.quote: He is a little bit more intense than I expected. You know, obviously playing against him last year, he always seemed like a cool, quiet coach from the sideline. He was really intense getting after it today, so that was a cool thing.
quotes.social_post: Unidentified speaker says he was surprised by Coach Adelman's intensity during practice, noting that he seemed like a cool and quiet coach when playing against him last year.
